name: Local info card
purpose: Facts for one town as label and value pairs, with the time they were updated and a source link. The caller supplies every value from a named source. The card never invents a reading.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Heading, such as the town name.

inputs.name: uid
inputs.description: Short id that keeps element ids unique when the item is used twice on one page.

inputs.name: updated
inputs.description: When the values were updated, as shown.

inputs.name: iso
inputs.description: Same time as YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO time.

field_notes.label: for example Forecast, High, Low, Wind, River stage
field_notes.value: text from the source, units included

verified_in: headless Chrome/Edge at 360 px and 1280 px
